gen-gf-itim-switzer: Casual and friendly, Itim looks scribbled in pen with a loose, low line. Switzer follows in a plain sans, wiry and tubular, its tall waist line giving the handwriting something firm to lean on.
gen-gf-itim-work-sans: Work Sans has a modern, level look, its diagonals carrying as much heft as its stems. Itim does the opposite job, offering a loose, pen-scribbled friendliness, while Work Sans keeps its high mean line tidy in a plain sans.
gen-gf-jaini-fs-paquito: Crowded, rowdy letters, like logs jammed in a river. Paquito, a text serif with barely any step from lowercase to caps, would swallow the heading's spaghetti-line energy if Jaini were made small, so give Jaini room.
gen-gf-jaini-purva-fs-paquito: Expressive and bold, Jaini Purva fits its glyphs together like keyed puzzle pieces, one thickness all the way through. And Paquito, a text serif with hardly any gap between lowercase and capitals, gives that heft a confident, approachable partner.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-archivo: Jim Nightshade is all marker-like bowls as heavy as its stems, packed tight into a dark, relaxed texture. And Archivo, a plain sans with a commanding x-height and curves opening outward, gives that scrawl some editorial space.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-fs-asap: Asap is readable and trim, a plain sans whose body height nearly matches its capitals. Jim Nightshade earns its keep big and short, where its thickness-never-changing, close-set scrawl can blur into a dark, casual texture.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is a tall-bodied sans-serif with stubby ascender tips and curvy, unclamped letters on a wire-like skeleton. Jim Nightshade earns its place big and short.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-fs-public-sans: Bold, scrawled, relaxed letters with no thick or thin to them. Public Sans steps in beneath with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, a sans that gives the handwriting a sturdy footing.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-fs-supreme: Supreme is crisp, a sans-serif with a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle. Its letters held open rather than curled shut contrast with Jim Nightshade's marker-tip scrawl, which is relaxed and casual.
gen-gf-jim-nightshade-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a big x-height and a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, a sans of steady pen pressure. And Jim Nightshade, relaxed and tightly set, adds a casual scrawl above it.
